# Catholic Leaders in Action

> Catholic Leaders in Action is a community formed in partnership with the Archdiocese of San Francisco. It hosts free monthly evenings in San Francisco for Catholic young professionals ages 21 to 40.

## Key information

- Monthly evenings combine Catholic formation, conversation, friendship, and opportunities for service.
- The next listed evening is Called to Relationship on October 6, 2026, from 6:30 to 9:30 PM in San Francisco.
- Event registration and the full schedule are hosted on Luma.

## Official links
